periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical orientation, approximately 80 to 90 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Narrow oval shape, with the vertical height significantly exceeding the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering toward the snout, creating an asymmetrical teardrop effect.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, with the distance between ears roughly equivalent to the width of the cranial dome.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex curvature at the superior boundaries of the dark ear regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, large, roughly circular area on the cranial vertex where dark fur is absent, exposing pinkish-white tissue.
other_distinctive_markers: The dark fur forms a sharp, high-contrast collar that isolates the lower facial region from the rest of the body.
